text: Put n equal to three. Factorise z cubed minus one: z minus one, times z squared plus z plus one. So one root is one, and the quadratic gives the other two: minus one plus or minus i root three, over two. Call the first omega. The other is omega squared. On the diagram, they are an equilateral triangle on the unit circle.
